research_notes: guessed domain theblissfulbakerpsl.com does not resolve (DNS failure). WebSearch for 'The Blissful Baker' + Port St. Lucie + instagram, + facebook, + contact/email, and for plausible IG handles (blissfulbaker/blissful_baker) found no matching page; only unrelated similarly-named bakeries elsewhere (Baked By Crissy in Miami, Blissful Sweets Bakery in Kissimmee, Blissful Batters unknown state). No listing on TheKnot/Zola/WeddingWire either, unlike other Port St. Lucie cake vendors (e.g. Cakes by Michelle, Sandra's Cakes). Confirms has_own_site: false and no public email/IG. Owner's first name (Mary) confirmed independently by 4 separate Google reviewers. Hours scraped from Maps ('7 AM to 11 PM' every day including today) look like a parsing artifact (implausible 16h window for a home bakery) and were NOT used in content.json per 'omit unreliable data, never invent'. Extra reviews pulled with a standalone Playwright run (MAPS_INCLUDE_REVIEWS=1 + manual scroll/expand) beyond the two first captured: Gabriella Bemis (full text) and Jaquin (truncated, mentions finding the business on Facebook, but no public Facebook page was found in search).
